text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro McQueen's momentous debut race is today.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Yes, I'm fine. I'm a little nervous, it's true, but…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: It's an exhilarating feeling to know that, starting now, I'm truly moving toward my goal.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: This is the first step on the road to conquering the Tenno Sho. …Now, here I go!
